mathematical_result.statement: For every R>2, if C_* is the sharp universal target density constant and s(A)=s_3(A), then C_* = sup_{target A,f,y>=R} [s(A)/2] P{1<|X^T A X-y|<2}. In particular R=4 restricts the exact sharp problem to a fixed positive-output shell entirely above Q=2.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: [s/2] P{1<|Q-y|<2} <= pi sqrt(2) s/kappa + [s/2] P{1<|Q-y|<2, minority}, where kappa=sigma_min(B) for an invertible indefinite original-coordinate 3x3 principal block B.

regularity_premise.scope: rank(A)>=3 implies an individually bounded C_0 density; matrix-dependent height allowed

unresolved_implication: Bound the fixed far-positive annulus uniformly. On a well-conditioned indefinite physical 3x3 block the majority sheet is already paid; control the minority/two-sheet shell or force a bank/ridge/mixed-frame/definite exit before reciprocal near-singular-minor payment.
